//: What real padel measures (docs/research/sound.md has the sources and how each number was read). Tools and tests compare the synthesis with these; the game doesn't read them. psd: the smoothed power spectrum of one hit in dB against its own top, read off Wadman et al. 2021 Fig. 4.3.2 (10 dB = 62 px; a padel cage, microphone 2 m, the mesh 1.5 m; below about 125 Hz the curves meet the background, so they aren't used). lafmax: their Fig. 4.2.3, dBA. cageT20: their Fig. 4.2.5, the outdoor cage's reverberation in seconds. meshDecay: seconds after its top and dB against it, read off Fig. 4.3.1. piana: A-weighted third-octave sound power of a whole game without shouting, dB(A), read off Piana et al. 2025 Fig. 6.
